title: Design Amazon Product Page
definition: An Amazon product page requires extreme SEO optimization (Server Side Rendering), Micro Frontends (one team builds the Reviews section, one builds the Buy Box), and extreme caching strategies.
simpleExplanation: A single page where 5 different engineering teams are displaying 5 different widgets simultaneously, but it must load in under 1 second so you don't leave and buy the item somewhere else.

basic: What are the core requirements for Amazon Product Page?
intermediate: How do you handle edge cases and accessibility in Amazon Product Page?
advanced: How do you scale and optimize Amazon Product Page for millions of concurrent users?
trick: What happens to Amazon Product Page if JavaScript is disabled?

answers.question: Define Amazon Product Page.
answers.answer: A complex system design problem requiring deep architectural knowledge.
